ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: My prior routing stands. I selected Dunlin-235B because it outperforms Willet-235B across the board on internal evals (e.g., Extraction & Retrieval 85.3 vs 79.2, Summarization 86.4 vs 80.6) and public benchmarks (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2).
